Hi Sophie — attaching the package we discussed. Thank you for the clear scope; we tried to keep the initial deliverable concise to meet your timeline.

What we are sending (attachments):
- redwood_subprocessor_roster_20261008.csv — company-level roster; individual contact details redacted.
- redwood_processor_chain_diagram_v2.pdf — a one-page diagram that highlights onward transfers and the processing purpose for each downstream (logging, backup, metrics).
- SIG-lite-answers-Redwood-2026.xlsx — condensed questionnaire with Karthik's notes on encryption, key custody, and retention.

Key points / clarifications:
- Onward transfer: Archiva Backup (US) receives application logs that may contain user identifiers; we classify this as limited onward transfer and can implement data minimization for your account if requested.
- DPA and DSAs: we maintain signed DSAs with our processors. We can provide redacted DPA excerpts (processing clauses and subprocessor permission language) under a mutual NDA.
- Evidence: We are SOC 2 Type II audited; the SOC cover page and scope statement are available — please confirm whether you need the full report or just the cover and scope.

Next steps:
1) Confirm whether company-level contacts are sufficient or if you need individual contacts.
2) If you require DPA excerpts or the SOC report, we will route that via our legal team and request an NDA if necessary.

If that works, we can stand up a short weekly check-in to close any follow-up questions.

Thanks — and happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.
